From the materials provided you produce (1) an optimized CV that restates what the materials establish about the candidate for the target role and (2) a HiringEvidencePacket that maps each job requirement to evidence, records unsupported claims, evidence gaps, interview-signal risks and follow-up questions, and supports qualified human review. Use only the provided materials.

Output contract. Return exactly one JSON object and nothing else, with this shape:
{
 "schemaVersion": "jam.hrgene_paired_review_bundle.model_output.v2",
 "optimizedCv": {
  "language": "<case language: en or zh-CN>", "candidateId": "<copy from the case>", "targetRoleTitle": "<role title>",
  "professionalSummary": [CLAIM...], "experienceHighlights": [CLAIM...], "projectsAndWorkSamples": [CLAIM...], "skills": [CLAIM...],
  "evidenceBoundary": "<one or two sentences on what the materials do and do not establish>"
 },
 "hiringEvidencePacket": {
  "decisionBoundary": {"employmentDecisionMade": false, "candidateRanked": false, "protectedCharacteristicsInferred": false, "humanReviewRequired": true, "statement": "<sentence>"},
  "role": {"roleTitle": "<role title>", "jobDescriptionSource": "<copy jobDescriptionSourceId from the case>", "requirementIds": ["<every requirementId>"]},
  "candidate": {"candidateId": "<copy from the case>", "sources": ["<every sourceId you used>"]},
  "requirementEvidenceMap": [{"requirementId": "<id>", "status": "supported|partial_evidence|insufficient_evidence",
     "evidence": [{"sourceId": "<id>", "text": "<verbatim passage from that source>", "evidenceStrength": "low|medium|high", "notes": "<short note>"}],
     "missingEvidence": ["<what is missing, if anything>"]}],
  "supportedClaims": [{"claim": "<statement>", "supportingRequirementIds": ["<id>"], "sourceIds": ["<id>"], "evidenceStrength": "low|medium|high", "witness": "<verbatim passage from a cited source>"}],
  "unsupportedClaims": [{"claim": "<statement that the materials do not establish>", "reason": "<why>", "requiredFollowUp": "<what would establish it>"}],
  "missingEvidenceGaps": [{"gapId": "<id>", "requirementId": "<id>", "severity": "low|medium|high", "gap": "<what is missing>"}],
  "interviewSignalRisks": [{"sourceId": "<id>", "text": "<the signal>", "signalType": "<type>", "jobRelatedBoundary": "<is it tied to job-related evidence?>", "severity": "low|medium|high", "recommendedHandling": "<how to verify>"}],
  "followUpQuestions": [{"questionId": "<id>", "requirementId": "<id>", "question": "<neutral question>", "evidenceTarget": "<what evidence it seeks>"}],
  "humanReviewChecklist": ["<item>"], "auditSummary": "<paragraph>", "limitations": ["<item>"]
 }
}
CLAIM = {"claimId": "<id>", "text": "<statement>", "sourceIds": ["<id>"], "requirementIds": ["<id>"], "supportBoundary": "supported|partial_evidence", "witness": "<verbatim passage from a cited source, or empty string>"}
Every array may be empty except requirementEvidenceMap, which must cover every requirementId once.

Case 05650ced-3ace-4fa0-a8ff-e9dce028a9ff (language: en).

Target role: Change Management Specialist, Mobile App Services
Job description (jobDescriptionSourceId jd_6c35954468d28732): Mobile app services runs the release train for a consumer banking app across iOS and Android. The Change Management Specialist prepares change requests for the fortnightly release, checks that each change has a rollback plan and test evidence, records approvals from the change advisory board, and keeps the change calendar current. The role works with the app engineering squads, QA and the operations manager; final go/no-go for each release stays with the change advisory board.

Requirements:
- req_69a9101c8ca1: Prepares and quality-checks change requests for the fortnightly mobile release, including rollback plan and test evidence.
- req_3e76803c8feb: Records change advisory board decisions and keeps the change calendar current.
- req_5a0c68b5be5e: Coordinates with engineering squads and QA to close open items before the release freeze.
- req_42ae61bea811: Prepares the post-release summary with incidents, rollbacks and open items for the operations manager.
- req_c08fb548a158: Documents known limitations and hand-over conditions for each release cycle.

Candidate identifier: cand_888e734b72655df0

Original CV (markdown):
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Change Management Specialist, Mobile App Services

## Experience

- Prepared change requests for eleven fortnightly releases of the banking app, checking each request for a rollback plan, linked test evidence and a named owner before submission to the change advisory board.
- Recorded change advisory board decisions in the change tool and kept the release calendar current; the board chair took the go/no-go decision and I published the outcome to the squads.
- Ran the pre-freeze checklist with the four app squads and QA, chasing open items and escalating unresolved ones to the operations manager two days before each freeze.
- Wrote the post-release summary for each cycle, listing incidents, any rollback and the open items carried into the next cycle, which the operations manager reviewed.
- Responsibilities included change-request preparation, board record keeping, pre-freeze coordination and post-release reporting for the mobile release train over about a year.

## Work samples

- Work sample: an anonymised change-request pack for one release (request list, rollback plans, test-evidence links, board decision record) and the post-release summary, with the change tool's audit history as a verification trail.

Case 07ce4974-31a2-44ec-8933-75297a497cea (language: en).

Target role: Field Service Operations Manager, Elevator Maintenance Scheduling
Job description (jobDescriptionSourceId jd_ecf3a791374d00d3): Technicians across the northern region are dispatched to elevator maintenance and repair jobs by the scheduling system, and the branches depend on it every working hour. This manager is the person who keeps that dispatching running: primary holder of the dispatch desk's production support rota, first responder when dispatching stops, the coordinator of vendor changes into the live system, the keeper of the response-time figures used in service contract reviews, and the author of the notes that record what the service can and cannot do after each incident. Reports to the regional service director; works daily with the dispatch desk, eleven branches and the vendor's support team.

Requirements:
- req_f5a3b92ea0f2: Keeps the dispatch system dispatching in live operation and is the first responder when a production incident stops dispatching.
- req_a68647feaad9: Is the primary holder of the dispatch desk's production support rota and the branch escalation route.
- req_7d6b21bb775e: Brings vendor changes into the live system through the quarterly change window and records where own checks end and the vendor's begin.
- req_df833cd9f2c8: Keeps the dispatch runbook and the response-time figures for service contract reviews current.
- req_97fd34526723: Records known limitations and hand-over conditions in the post-incident and change notes.

Candidate identifier: cand_e6a427d3c7132dce

Original CV (markdown):
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Field Service Operations Manager, Elevator Maintenance Scheduling

## Experience

- Primary holder of the production support rota for the elevator dispatch desk in the northern region from 2021 to 2025, with the branch escalation route running through me during working hours and the duty phone outside them.
- First responder to every production incident that stopped dispatching in those four years; the three vendor outages of 2023 and 2024 are logged under my name in the regional incident log with the vendor's ticket numbers.
- Brought the vendor's scheduling releases into the live system through the quarterly change window, with the change log recording my acceptance checks separately from the vendor's regression checks.
- Kept the dispatch runbook and the response-time figures for the eleven branches current for the service contract reviews, revising the runbook after each incident and each release.
- Wrote the post-incident notes and the release hand-over notes, recording the known limitations of the technician availability feed and what the next rota holder needed to know.

## Work samples

- Work sample: regional incident log extracts for the three vendor outages with the vendor ticket numbers, the change log for the last four quarterly windows and the current dispatch runbook.

- src_319f3dda9d04 [work_sample]: Work sample: regional incident log extracts for the three vendor outages with the vendor ticket numbers, the change log for the last four quarterly windows and the current dispatch runbook.
- src_95bd4f537145 [note]: Recruiter screen: asked what 'running the dispatch system' meant in practice, the candidate described holding the rota, taking the three vendor outage calls and running the change windows; the dates he gave agree with the resume and the incident log extracts.
- src_956443f4f2f9 [note]: Hiring manager pre-read: the regional service director asks that the packet cite the incident log extracts by ticket number and show the rota period, and that any vendor test-environment activity be listed separately from live operation.

Target role: Service Operations Manager, Cloud Resource Management Product
Job description (jobDescriptionSourceId jd_9353ac3319f1fdaa): The cloud resource management product gives enterprise customers a console for provisioning and cost control across their cloud accounts. The Service Operations Manager runs the product's live service: owns the production on-call rota, has led production incident response for customer-facing outages, coordinates production changes with engineering and customer success, and is accountable for the service's availability commitments to customers.

Requirements:
- req_bb6818ef1e6f: Has run the product's live service and led production incident response for customer-facing outages.
- req_ac0708d2a2e4: Owns the production on-call rota and the incident communication procedure.
- req_17df1af41ebb: Coordinates production changes with engineering and customer success during change windows and records own responsibility boundaries.
- req_a903e178cdb9: Maintains the service runbooks and the availability reporting for customers.
- req_17df3aa4ce51: Documents known limitations and hand-over conditions after each incident and change.

Candidate identifier: cand_8d0e06647ab21bb3

# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Service Operations Manager, Cloud Resource Management Product

## Experience

- Ran the staging environment for the resource management console as the service coordinator for the pre-release programme, executing the release rehearsal checklist for eleven candidate releases and leading the rehearsal incident drills with the engineering team.
- Maintained the service runbooks and the availability report template that the live service team used, updating the runbooks after each rehearsal with the steps that had failed.
- Coordinated staging changes with engineering and customer success in the pre-release change window; production changes and customer-facing incidents were handled by the live service team under its own on-call rota, which I was not part of.
- Wrote the rehearsal report after each drill, listing the known limitation that staging carried synthetic customer accounts only and the hand-over items for the live service team.
- Responsibilities included staging coordination, release rehearsals, incident drills, runbook maintenance and rehearsal reports for the console's pre-release programme over about two years.

## Work samples

- Work sample: the release rehearsal checklist with the drill log for eleven releases and one rehearsal report, with the staging environment's release identifiers as a verification trail.

Requirements:
- req_1b08751c602c: Owns the triage model end-to-end, including training data, model design and release decisions.
- req_450d25fcc8ea: Builds and maintains the training and evaluation pipelines for the triage model.
- req_39f96e5eb821: Monitors the model in production and runs the monthly model review with claims operations.
- req_ba1bd7e3653e: Coordinates model changes with claims operations and the model risk team and records own responsibility boundaries.
- req_0b15760ead12: Documents model cards, known limitations and hand-over conditions for each model version.

Target role: Machine Learning Engineer, Insurance Claims Platform
